title: Szechuan Lentil Bake
description: A flavorful and spicy take on a traditional Chinese dish. Lentils are baked with aromatic spices and zesty Spanish sauce.

ingredients.name: Lentils
ingredients.notes: Red or green, rinsed and drained

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the lentils, bake mix, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sugar, and red pepper flakes.
Add the Zesty Spanish Sauce and mix until the lentils are well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the top is lightly browned.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
